name: Kizuki Construction
description: Kizuki Construction — a theme for a general construction contractor, set as one clean reading column under a formal white split header: the company name in the centre, the menu split two left and two right, and a Request a site survey button at the far right. Konjo navy (#113285) is the main colour: the metrics ledger, the survey call, every page head and the buttons are navy fields in white type. The front page is a metrics ledger: a white first screen on a 12-column grid with a giant handover count (1,284) in bengara Roboto Condensed on the left, the headline, one paragraph and one button on the right and a thin documentary photo strip of a concrete pour along the bottom; then a ledger of six published figures on a navy field, a ten-year safety trend chart, a register of eight recent projects with photo thumbnails, one wide site photograph, report downloads and a navy survey call where a transparent cut-out safety helmet breaks out over the band edge. Photographs are realistic documentary images (35mm wide, available light, handheld, fine grain, graded toward navy). Zen Kaku Gothic Antique for headings, Roboto Condensed for text and figures, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
